main_body: A narrow strip with a vertical plank column on the left and a stack of three identical short posts on the right, each with a lighter cap square, a brown shaft and grey bracket tabs above and below
top_band: Pale orange cap with a darker cross mark, rows ~2-6 on each post. It is about as wide as the post and looks like a knotted face, not a foreshortened horizontal surface. No clear front-edge step follows it.
evidence: Reading down a post column gives a light cap block (~rows 2-6) that blends straight into the brown shaft, with no distinct front-edge line and no eave shadow. The plank column on the left is a flat vertical face. The grey brackets are thin horizontal bars with no visible top surface. As a frame, its beams and base show no top faces, so it reads as a front elevation with a hat.

style.evidence: The posts have about 3-4 brown tones and a few grain dots, and the left plank column is nearly flat vertical stripes. The very dark near-black background and outlines look sticker-like rather than the dark material tone the references use. The grey brackets are flat 2-3 colour fills. It is thinner than the roofed well and the cheese stall.
